name: Burst Sac spatter
description: What Burst Sac makes of an overkill: the leftover force leaving the body it landed in. A dark wet stain on the ground, eight drops of it thrown round the corpse and none of them past the ring, one blood ring whose outer edge lands at r=30 at full expansion — the game scales the document so that r=30 is the burst radius, the same contract as the barb burst — and a coral flash at the middle that is gone first. It is deliberately plain, for the reason Quicklime's vent is: this goes off on every kill that had damage left over, which in a crowd is several times a second, and the seven thrown lobes, the drops riding their tips and the curled scraps of sac wall it used to carry turned every one of those into a star over the corpse, and a field of them into noise. What is left is the one thing the effect has to say, which is how far the spill reached: the ring marks the edge, the stain and the drops say it was a body and not a detonation. Blood rather than the badge's ember, because on the field ember is what a mine's crater is tinted — so nothing here is fire, nothing is frost (the player's weapon breaking shell) and nothing is magenta (the hive). Spawn it on the body that burst.

play.description: A shade over a quarter of a second, the length of Quicklime's vent and shorter than the blast, because a thing that goes off on every overkill must not hold the screen. The flash first and gone by the halfway mark; the ring behind it, settling on the radius that hurt so what was seen and what was hit are the same circle; the stain and the drops on the ground last, still there as the sprite fades.
